issues.problem: Gaussian budget will likely abort the large outdoor scenes. GOF's quantile abs-gradient criterion selects up to ~2x the 3DGS candidates per densify step; the garden smoke already has 1.88x gsplat's count at 2k (1.58M vs 0.84M). Our 30k gsplat bicycle has 6.59M Gaussians and Mip-Splatting has 7.14M, so GOF bicycle (and possibly treehill/garden) can go past 12M. The runtime then raises 'Gaussian budget exceeded' and the run stops, so the 9-scene group average cannot be computed.
issues.evidence: runtime.py:213-216 raises when len(means) > max_gaussians; bench.py:196 hard-codes 12000000; evidence/smoke-1/test.json gaussians 1582874 vs smoke-baseline 839687; runs/baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-30000/gsplat/mipnerf360-bicycle 6590201.
issues.fix: Set bench_request extra to "--max-gaussians 20000000" (argparse takes the last value, and extra is appended). Memory: about 1.65 GB per 1M Gaussians from the smoke (2.6 GB at 1.58M), so roughly 25-35 GB at 15-20M. That fits a 48 GB A6000, but bench should use --min-free-gb ~36 for outdoor scenes. Keep the official screen-size quirk (prune does not change). Note: torch.quantile fails above 2^24 = 16.8M elements, the same limit as the official code.

minor_issues.problem: Order differs from official. Official runs densify -> compute_3D_filter -> reset_opacity. Here it is densify -> reset_opacity -> update_filter, so at steps 3000..12000 the reset uses filter_3d values copied from the parents for the new clones (whose positions were resampled) and the previous step's filter for everyone else. The ceiling 0.01/coef is slightly off. Tiny effect.
minor_issues.fix: Call update_filter inside the densify branch before reset_opacity, then skip the duplicate is_filter_step update on that step.

minor_issues.problem: Optimizer-step ordering: in the official code the Adam step is effectively skipped on every densify step and on the opacity param at resets (new nn.Parameters have grad=None). The runtime steps before densifying. Documented but not listed in plan fidelity gaps. Negligible.

The filter-aware reset check (filtered opacity <= 0.01) also passes for a plain unfiltered 3DGS reset, because sigmoid=0.01 gives filtered = 0.01*coef <= 0.01. It does not detect removal of filter awareness.
minor_issues.fix: Use a Gaussian with filter_3d > 0 and opacity 0.5, then assert filtered == 0.01 (unfiltered reset gives < 0.01).

minor_issues.problem: degree = (step-1)//1000 raises SH one step later than official (iteration % 1000 == 0 at the start of the iteration). Shared with the baseline; negligible.
Says 'expect ~1.5-2x gsplat' time, but the smoke measured 727 s vs 145 s (5x) at 2k, with more Gaussians to come. 30k outdoor runs may take many hours; plan the GPU time accordingly.

The 2k smoke deficit (22.25 vs 22.99) is mostly an artefact: the GOF density forces the official xyz LR schedule with position_lr_max_steps=30000 (lr at 2k = 1.18e-4*extent), while gsplat's runtime decays over --steps=2000 (lr at 2k = 1.6e-6*extent, 74x smaller). Train loss is lower for GOF (0.088 vs 0.105) and LPIPS is better (0.374 vs 0.419), which fits under-converged positions rather than a bug. Black background is not a factor: Mip-NeRF 360 JPGs have no alpha, and the renderer owns the background in train and eval. The smoke is not evidence for or against fidelity.
minor_issues.fix: State this in report.md. For a fair short smoke, pass position_lr_max_steps=steps to both methods, or compare only at 30k.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: Kernel sources byte-identical to official submodule @5245b20 (all .cu/.h/ext.cpp diffs empty).

Centred principal point holds: all 9 mipnerf360 native scenes, every frame |cx-W/2|,|cy-H/2| <= 0.5; projmatrix with 2cx/W-1 = 0 equals the official FoV projection; tanfov = W/(2fx), H/(2fy) as official.

Screen-size prune quirk confirmed: gaussian_model.py:629 densification_postfix sets max_radii2D = zeros. It runs in both clone and split, even with empty selections, before the prune check at :701, so big_points_vs never fires. World-size prune is active only when size_threshold is set (iteration > 3000), matching world_prune = step > 3000.

Hyper-parameters match arguments/__init__.py + train.py + run_mipnerf360.py: lambda_dssim 0.2, lambda_distortion 100, lambda_depth_normal 0.05 (both >= 15000), densify 500 < it < 15000 every 100, thr 2e-4, percent_dense 0.01, min_opacity 0.05, reset every 3000 (< 15000), xyz lr 1.6e-4 -> 1.6e-6 x extent over 30000 (delay_steps 0), feature 0.0025 / rest /20, opacity 0.05, scaling 0.005, rotation 0.001, Adam eps 1e-15, kernel_size 0, white_background False, opacity init 0.1, 3-NN scales. 3D filter every 100 steps for 500<it<15000 (after densify) and 15000<it<29900. Script: images_4 outdoor / images_2 indoor, --eval (llffhold 8), all < 1600 px so no resize.

Official eval (render.py) renders with get_*_with_3D_filter, i.e. the 3D filter is used at test time with a black background. Our evaluator calls the same renderer with the stored filter_3d, so this matches.

paper_results.json targets match tables/mipnerf-360.tex (24.82/0.750/0.202, 30.79/0.924/0.184; 3DGS 24.64/0.731/0.234, 30.41/0.920/0.189) and mipnerf-360-densify.tex ablations. The 3DGS group averages agree with the 3DGS paper per-scene numbers.
Random-with-replacement view sampling, eval SSIM valid-conv / lpips package (shared with baseline), no mesh extraction, no decoupled appearance (TnT only).
summary: The implementation is faithful. The kernel is unmodified, the Python side of render/depth_to_normal/losses matches line by line, and the density recipe and every Mip-NeRF 360 hyper-parameter match the official code. Probes are mechanism-level, and pytest (5) and ss-verify (all probes) pass on GPU. No critical issues. One major issue blocks the protocol run: bench.py's fixed --max-gaussians 12M is likely to abort bicycle (gsplat 6.6M x ~1.9 GOF growth), so raise it via extra. The 2k smoke deficit is explained by the official 30k-step xyz LR schedule against gsplat's schedule compressed to 2k steps, not by background, filter or metric. Not approved only because of the budget risk; approve once bench_request extra is set to --max-gaussians 20000000 (with enough free GPU memory).
